sources.section: Electrical System Generation 7 in a nutshell; Scania Workshop Suite

variants.rollout: gradual during 2024; no universal VIN/year cutoff established

evidence.fact: The Gen 7 transition coincides with gradual introduction of Smart Dash; visual appearance or registration year alone does not establish the configuration.
P9 is the cab bodybuilder electrical unit, P11 the chassis electrical unit; bodywork interface remains broadly unchanged. Neither is a BMS identification or mounting proof.
SWS supports both generations; Gen 7 replaces SDP3 for diagnostic connection. The official tools page identifies VCI4 for cybersecure Gen 7.

scope.warning: Electrical system generation 7 is not proof of EBS7. Require independent brake-system variant evidence.
